kristaps porzingis.comment: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

myron gardner.comment: Gardner (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game against the Bucks.

ousmane dieng.comment: Dieng will undergo a procedure to repair a fractured left finger Monday, Justin Garcia of the Milwaukee Bucks Radio Network reports.

jaylen clark.comment: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.

anthony edwards.comment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

donte divincenzo.comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

bryce mcgowens.comment: McGowens (elbow) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Thunder.

dejounte murray.comment: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

alex caruso.comment: Caruso won't return to Wednesday's game against the Hawks due to right hip soreness, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

jonathan isaac.comment: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Celtics.

noah penda.comment: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

dominick barlow.comment: Barlow (back) is out for Wednesday's game against Orlando.

mark williams.comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

toumani camara.comment: Camara is questionable to play Thursday against the Bucks due to general soreness.

vit krejci.comment: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

ja morant.comment: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. shaedon sharpe.comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

maxime raynaud.comment: Raynaud (knee) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Suns.

ben simmons.comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
